description.zh:
指定返回结果中管控策略描述的语言。取值：

- zh-CN（默认值）：中文。
- en：英文。
- ja：日文。

> 该参数仅在系统管控策略时有效。
description.en:
The language in which you want to return the descriptions of the access control policies. Valid values:

*   zh-CN (default value): Chinese
*   en: English
*   ja: Japanese

>  This parameter is valid only for system access control policies.

description.zh:
目标节点。取值：

- Root ID：查询Root节点绑定的管控策略。
- 资源夹ID：查询资源夹绑定的管控策略。
- 成员ID：查询成员绑定的管控策略。
description.en:
The ID of the object whose access control policies you want to query. Access control policies can be attached to the following objects:

*   Root folder
*   Subfolders of the Root folder
*   Members

title.zh: 查询节点绑定的管控策略

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询资源夹`fd-ZDNPiT****`绑定的管控策略列表。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to query the access control policies that are attached to the folder `fd-ZDNPiT****`.
